shared_receipt_rules: Each batch contains exactly one complete process-tree resource receipt.
The receipt ID is the SHA-256 of its canonical receipt body.
Every artifact binding names the one receipt ID and the SHA-256 of one strict v1 input and output pair.
Every embedded v1 output retains its required resource object, but all 23 copies must equal the shared receipt resource projection byte-for-byte.
Aggregate resource accounting charges the unique receipt ID once, never once per artifact binding.
Cost ledgers remain artifact-local and are not replaced by the process-tree receipt.
Primary and independent base-contract verifiers must accept all 46 input-output pairs.
Unknown fields, duplicate artifact IDs, duplicate output digests, changed receipt IDs, missing bindings, and inflated integration claims fail closed.
